description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named ExternalStorage that demonstrates handling external storage in Android. It includes functionality for creating, deleting, and checking for media files in external storage directories, as well as monitoring storage state changes.

classes.name: ExternalStorage
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating external storage handling, including creating, deleting files, and monitoring storage state.

classes.name: ExternalStorage.Item
classes.description: Inner static class representing UI controls for storage management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and starts monitoring external storage.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops storage monitoring when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: handleExternalStorageState
methods.description: Enables or disables UI controls based on storage availability and writeability.

methods.name: updateExternalStorageState
methods.description: Checks current external storage state and updates internal flags.

methods.name: startWatchingExternalStorage
methods.description: Registers BroadcastReceiver to monitor external storage mount/unmount events.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePublicPicture
methods.description: Copies a resource image to the public pictures directory and scans it for media.

methods.name: deleteExternalStoragePublicPicture
methods.description: Deletes the public picture file from external storage.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePublicPicture
methods.description: Checks existence of the public picture file.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePrivatePicture
methods.description: Copies a resource image to an app-private external pictures directory and scans it.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePrivatePicture
methods.description: Checks existence of the private picture file.

methods.name: createExternalStoragePrivateFile
methods.description: Creates a private file on external storage by copying a resource into external files directory.

methods.name: deleteExternalStoragePrivateFile
methods.description: Deletes the private file from external storage.

methods.name: hasExternalStoragePrivateFile
methods.description: Checks if the private file exists.

methods.name: createStorageControls
methods.description: Creates UI control set for storage actions including labels, create, and delete buttons.
